description: The true path of the miniature: one narrator saw who left the table and when, the other saw the hall for part of the evening; neither account answers alone, and together they leave one guest.

moves.why: Clara watched Captain Voss the whole time he was out.
He fetched something from his coat and went straight back.
And nobody else crossed the hall while she sat there.
So the notes went after the joint, when the hall was unwatched.

moves.see: Miss Pym went out during the dessert
moves.why: George saw only one person leave the table after that.
